title: ToolEmu High-Stakes Risk Replicated in a Real Sandbox

original_idea.body: # ToolEmu High-Stakes Risk Replicated in a Real Sandbox

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: emulator-fidelity bias affects every emulator-based safety eval; foundational infrastructure value.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: re-implement a few inert tools, run existing agent under two backends; tractable.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused first deliverable (15-20 cases, two backends) with limited dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected safer-sandbox methodology audit labs rely on but rarely externally validate.

novelty.reasoning: ToolEmu known; real-vs-emulated fidelity comparison may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Emulator validation against real tools likely under-explored.
